eyebrow.zh: 国产大模型 · 个人盲测评测
eyebrow.en: Personal blind tasting for CN models

headline.zh:
榜单会被刷分，
你的口味不会。
headline.en:
Leaderboards can be farmed.
Your taste cannot.

sub.zh: BlindTaste 把改简历、写周报、PPT 大纲、翻译这些高频任务打包成 10 分钟终端盲测：逐对匿名 A/B 投票、票仓断点续跑，先看清你自己任务上的稳定偏好，再决定用哪个模型。v0.1 实现盲测电池（init + run）。
sub.en: BlindTaste packs your recurring tasks - resume edits, weekly reports, deck outlines, translation - into a 10-minute terminal blind test: vote on anonymous A/B pairs, resume anytime, and see your stable preference on your own tasks before picking a model. v0.1 ships the blind battery (init + run).

caption.zh: 先看清自己的偏好，再谈选型
caption.en: See your own preference first, then choose

title.zh: 测的是你的任务，不是榜单的任务

body.zh: 8 道中文选择题圈出你每周真会做的任务（改简历/周报/PPT 大纲/翻译 + 自定义），生成 6-10 条任务电池；聚合榜单回答不了「哪个改我的简历更好」，电池回答得了。
body.en: Eight questions pin down the tasks you actually do every week (resume edits, weekly reports, deck outlines, translation, plus custom), building a 6-10 task battery. Aggregate boards cannot answer which one edits your resume better; your battery can.

body.zh: 票面只见匿名 A/B，两份回答并排对比、两次按键内投票；每张票记录盲序、选择与思考时长，投票后才揭晓模型——不请 LLM 当裁判，因为裁判互相附和不等于正确。
body.en: The ballot shows only anonymous A/B, two answers side by side, two keystrokes per vote; each vote records blind order, pick and think time, and models are revealed only after voting. No LLM judge - judges agreeing does not make them right.

body.zh: votes.jsonl 追加式落盘，按 trial_id 去重，Ctrl-C 之后重跑自动接上；trial 由电池内容指纹确定性生成，同一电池永远得到同一批对局。
body.en: votes.jsonl is an append-only store deduped by trial id; Ctrl-C and re-run picks up exactly where you stopped. Trials derive deterministically from the battery fingerprint, so the same battery always yields the same pairs.

title.zh: 先看清自己的偏好，再谈选型

body.zh: 国产旗舰全部免费、每月轮换，「哪个改我的周报更好」每个月都要重新回答一次。榜单会被刷分，裁判会互相附和，双开肉眼对比又受单次噪声影响。BlindTaste 把 Chatbot Arena 验证过的匿名双选机制下沉到个人：你的任务、你的票、你的电池。v0.1 交付盲测电池与票仓，重测信度评分与个人选型报告在 m2。
body.en: Every CN flagship is free and the rotation is monthly, so "which one writes my weekly report better" needs re-answering every drop. Leaderboards can be farmed, judges echo each other, and eyeballing two tabs is single-trial noise. BlindTaste brings the Arena-proven anonymous pairwise mechanism down to the personal scale: your tasks, your votes, your battery. v0.1 ships the battery and vote vault; retest reliability and the personal report land in m2.

body.zh: init 问卷生成电池，run 逐对盲选（约 15 对、10 分钟），每张票立即落盘；中断后重跑从上次进度继续。回答缓存按（模式, 模型, 任务）复用，同一任务不重复烧 API。
body.en: init builds the battery, run walks the pairs (about 15, 10 minutes), each vote hits disk immediately; interrupt and re-run resumes. Answer caching is keyed by (mode, model, task), so the same task never burns the API twice.

alt.en: init, run, vote recording and resume flow

body.zh: intake 负责问卷与电池，session 调度盲测对局并维护票仓，providers 把五家官方 OpenAI 兼容端点统一在一个接口后面（方舟未验证、best-effort），scoring 统计票面（m2 补 BT 排名与重测信度），report 是 m2 的报告出口。
body.en: intake owns the questionnaire and battery, session schedules pairs and keeps the vote vault, providers puts all five official OpenAI-compatible endpoints behind one interface (Ark unverified, best-effort), scoring tallies votes (m2 adds BT ranking and retest reliability), report is the m2 outlet.

alt.en: Data flow across cli, intake, session, providers, scoring, report

body.zh: 智谱（免费档）、DeepSeek、通义百炼、Kimi 走各自官方兼容端点；火山方舟（豆包）兼容性未验证，未配置 key 时给出明确错误，配置后仅 best-effort。另有 --demo 离线模拟适配器，不配 key 也能走通全流程。
body.en: Zhipu (free tier), DeepSeek, Qwen via Bailian, and Kimi use their official compatible endpoints; Volcengine Ark (Doubao) is unverified - it fails loudly when unconfigured and stays best-effort when configured. A --demo offline adapter walks the whole flow without any key.

alt.zh: 五家模型接入与离线演示适配器
alt.en: Five model integrations plus the offline demo adapter

body.zh: key 粘贴到 ~/.blindtaste/keys.env（ZHIPU_API_KEY=…），状态目录可用 BLINDTASTE_HOME 或 --home 覆盖。v0.1 只实现 m1：完整报告、重测一致率、噪声任务与榜单分歧表在 m2；--demo 的模拟回答不代表任何真实模型表现。
body.en: Paste keys into ~/.blindtaste/keys.env (ZHIPU_API_KEY=...); state directory can be overridden via BLINDTASTE_HOME or --home. v0.1 implements m1 only: the full report, retest agreement, noise tasks and index disagreement land in m2; --demo answers represent no real model.

note.zh: v0.1（m1）的真实终端输出：init → run --demo（3 票）→ 断点续跑（2 票）→ report。run 用离线模拟回答，不调用 API、不需要 key；问卷与投票输入以管道喂入，交互使用时逐题手输。
note.en: Real v0.1 (m1) terminal output: init -> run --demo (3 votes) -> resume (2 votes) -> report. run uses the offline demo adapter - no API, no keys; questionnaire and vote input is piped in the recording, typed interactively in normal use.

label.zh: init：8 道选择题 → 任务电池

body.zh: 问卷圈出你的四类高频任务（改简历/周报/PPT 大纲/翻译）与场景，生成 6-10 条任务的电池并选定 3 家参测模型。演示输入选择了全部四类、每类 2 条、智谱/DeepSeek/Kimi 三家。
body.en: The questionnaire pins down your four recurring task kinds and their scenarios, builds a 6-10 task battery and picks 3 models. This recorded input selected all four kinds, 2 tasks each, and Zhipu/DeepSeek/Kimi.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。不配 key 也能先跑 --demo；正式盲测把 1-2 个 key 粘贴进 ~/.blindtaste/keys.env（智谱 glm-4-flash-250414 有免费档）。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. --demo works without keys; for a real tasting paste 1-2 keys into ~/.blindtaste/keys.env (Zhipu glm-4-flash-250414 has a free tier).

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/blindtaste.git
cd blindtaste
uv tool install .   # 或 pip install -e .

blindtaste init            # 8 道选择题 -> 任务电池
# 把 key 粘贴到 ~/.blindtaste/keys.env
blindtaste run             # 匿名 A/B 盲选，Ctrl-C 可中断续跑

blindtaste run --demo --limit 2   # 不配 key、不调用 API
blindtaste report                 # 进度与票面统计

limitations.zh: v0.1 只实现 m1（init + run 盲测电池）；retest 重测一致率与 report 完整报告在 m2 交付。
limitations.en: v0.1 implements m1 only (init + run blind battery); retest reliability and the full report land in m2.

limitations.zh: 正式盲测需要各家官方 API key；--demo 的模拟回答不代表任何真实模型表现。
limitations.en: Real tasting needs official API keys; --demo answers represent no real model.

limitations.zh: 火山方舟（豆包）的 OpenAI 兼容性未验证，属 best-effort 接入。
limitations.en: Volcengine Ark (Doubao) OpenAI compatibility is unverified and best-effort.
